The curved body has no individually observed foot contacts. groundLineY is the painted lower envelope, not a claim that the whole tube lies on one plane.
Wet highlights and body thickness remain visual/style review questions; no native movement or quality acceptance.

coverage.scope: Additive source-owner correction on the identical Snail master
limitations: Independent source-coordinate Snail reference, a distinct canonical subject from the retained Banana Slug. No Slug landmarks or owners were transferred.

The targeted source successor has two upper ocular tentacles, two lower sensory tentacles and a separate small ventral oral opening at [913,734]. The lower tips remain plain painted sensory tips, not declared eyes.
The coarse gastropod template owns the two lower sensory tentacles with the head. It does not contain independent controls for them; all visible paint is retained.
The shell follows the existing rigid shell control. Four foot controls sample a continuous muscular foot, not four biological legs.
The edited eyes and mouth remain stylized and the shell has strong glossy highlights. Source visibility is not style or moving-paint acceptance.
No native run, reference-pool registration, family-wide admission or quality acceptance.

The original cast frame showed a detached root-owned 8px body square and two foot-remainder slivers beside the ocular stalks. The artificial root paint region is removed, so the existing foot2 owner receives the same continuous body pixels; root remains an unchanged rig landmark. The ocular polygons now cover their full observed stalk contours. No source pixel or landmark changes.

limitations: Provisional source-observed external-junction interpretation, not an internal anatomical reconstruction. Primary specimen text places the hinge on the anterior dorsal margin and the byssal gape ventrally. The source byssal/foot exit is lower-left around[550,755], opposite the closed anterior dorsal junction around[335,299]–[449,348].

The hinge anchor[377,326] lies on the visible narrow brown anterior external junction. It is not the wide open posterior mantle gape. Ligament-versus-periostracal-rim interpretation remains explicitly subject to full-size review. No unpainted internal hinge axis or mechanism is supplied.
Exactly two valves are painted. The existing bivalve template has one projected hinge control linked to both valve controls; this is a coarse projection, not a measured three-dimensional hinge axis.

A modest foot/byssal exit, connected mantle and short posterior aperture are present. No optional foot or siphon is declared absent or hidden merely to satisfy the template. Byssal threads remain on the foot owner; no independent thread joints are invented.
Closed material mapping uses plated shell/hinge and existing slick joint overrides for observed soft mantle, siphon and foot. No new material key or runtime change.
The primary Lander University specimen text was inspected; its diagram image links failed to render. No diagram inspection is claimed.
Eligibility is diagnostic review only if unchanged static checks pass. No biological certainty, gallery/pool admission, quality acceptance or native film is claimed.
